title: Cross-session messaging is judged against the file-and-pane relay
body:
Source: code.claude.com glossary (Subagent, cross-session-messaging). Separate Claude Code sessions can pass findings to each other directly. KRN passes lane verdicts and successor handoffs through files and Herdr panes (context-relay, successor-launch).
Outcome: a verdict file on whether cross-session messaging can replace the handoff file plus pane relay for successor start or lane verdict pickup. It names what breaks (persistence, the hc host, unattended runs).
Proof: one successor relay done through messaging in a trial, with the verdict file citing the transcript.
Files: scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts, src/successor/
